title: Rideshare Endorsement for the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy: Description and Premium
content:
The rideshare endorsement of the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy extends liability and physical damage coverage to the period a driver is logged into a transportation network company app and waiting for a ride request. This is the gap the network's own insurance does not cover.

## Availability and premium by package

| Package | Rideshare endorsement available | Full-term premium per endorsed vehicle, USD |
|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Auto Essential | No | 0.00 |
| Cardinal Auto Basic | No | 0.00 |
| Cardinal Auto Standard | Yes | 42.00 |
| Cardinal Auto Plus | Yes | 38.00 |
| Cardinal Auto Preferred | Yes | 36.00 |
| Cardinal Auto Premier | Yes | 68.00 |

## Conditions

- The endorsement may be added only where the package offers it, only to a scheduled vehicle, and only while the policy is in force.
- The policy status must be in force when a rideshare change is processed. The status is read from the record of the policy concerned.
- The endorsement premium is the package's rideshare premium per vehicle per term, prorated under the midterm premium change standard. It is a flat add-on to the full-term premium, never surcharged or discounted.
- Delivery driving for food or package delivery platforms is not covered by this endorsement.

## Hypothetical cases

| Package | Policy status | Vehicle | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Auto Plus | In force | Scheduled | May be added; full-term premium 38.00 for that vehicle |
| Cardinal Auto Basic | In force | Scheduled | Not available on the package |
| Cardinal Auto Standard | Bound | Scheduled | Not processed; the policy must be in force |
| Cardinal Auto Premier | In force | Delivery driving for a food platform | Not covered by this endorsement |
